item.title: Chain‐Networked Micro‐Silicon Electrodes Inducing Internal Isostatic Compressive Stress for High‐Energy and High‐Power Solid‐State Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty is a chain-networked micro-silicon electrode using CNT wrapping to induce internal isostatic compressive stress, mimicking Prince Rupert's drop. This prevents cracking without solid electrolyte, enabling 78% capacity retention at 3C and 78.8% after 3000 cycles at 5C in full cells. It significantly advances high-energy, high-power solid-state batteries.
🏷 micro-silicon anode · solid-state battery · carbon nanotube · compressive stress · high-power

item.title: Fluorination‐Tuned Covalent Organic Framework Interphases for Controllable LiF Content in Dendrite‐Free Lithium Metal Batteries

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers a fluorination-gradient COF artificial SEI strategy to precisely tune LiF content in lithium metal batteries. By controlling fluorine substitution (0F–4F), it reveals how electron-withdrawing F groups enhance LiPF₆ dissociation and oxidation stability (5.4 V), enabling 6000 h dendrite-free cycling and high-rate performance. This establishes COF fluorination as a new design paradigm for safe, high-energy LMBs.
🏷 lithium metal battery · covalent organic framework · LiF-rich SEI · fluorination · dendrite-free

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using a 3D MIEC garnet scaffold to enable uniform lithium nucleation within its pores, eliminating interfacial instability in “lithium-free” solid-state batteries. This yields 99.95% Coulombic efficiency and stable room-temperature cycling without pressure. The work reframes lithium nucleation as a percolation-governed transport process, guiding next-generation solid-state battery design.

چارچوب تریازین کووالانسی مبتنی بر بی‌پیریدین الکترون‌های نوری را ذخیره کرده و در تاریکی به‌صورت کنترل‌شده آزاد می‌کند و برای باتری خورشیدی آبی به کار می‌رود.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 CTF-Bpy is the first photochargeable covalent organic framework storing electrons reducing enough to drive dark H2 evolution. It achieves the most negative photo-OCP (−0.92 V) for an organic bifunctional material, enabling controlled dark release via discharge or O2 reduction. This establishes fully organic frameworks for dark photocatalysis and guides rational optoionic material design.
🏷 covalent triazine framework · light storage · bipyridine · solar battery · photocharging

item.title: Single-Atom Ce Enables Interfacial Pathway Regulation of Fe2 Atomic Pairs in Alkaline Oxygen Reduction
item.description:
افزودن Ce تک‌اتمی به جفت‌های Fe2 در کاتالیزور Fe-N-C مسیر 4e- واکنش اکسیژن را تقویت کرده و پایداری و عملکرد باتری Zn-air را بهبود می‌بخشد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Atomically dispersed Ce regulates the interfacial water/proton environment around Fe2 atomic pairs, suppressing the competing 2e– peroxide pathway and enabling the 4e– route. This decouples the activity–stability trade-off, yielding 0.92 V half-wave potential, 1.6% peroxide, 96% current retention over 50,000 s, and 1100 h Zn–air cycling—establishing interfacial pathway regulation as a design strategy for alkaline ORR catalysis.
🏷 oxygen reduction · Fe2 atomic pairs · single-atom Ce · Zn-air battery · interfacial water

item.title: Enhancing cycling stability by promoting high-voltage structural reversibility in high-nickel positive electrode materials
item.description:
مواد نانومیله‌ای نیکل بالا با برگشت‌پذیری ساختاری بهبودیافته، پایداری چرخه‌ای در ولتاژ بالا تا 4.95 V را در باتری لیتیوم-یون افزایش می‌دهند.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Nanorod high-nickel cathodes (including LiNiO₂) achieve stable cycling up to 4.95 V, unlike microcrystal counterparts. The novelty is that bulk structural reversibility, enabled by the nanorod morphology tolerating H2–H3 interphase lattice mismatch, allows full H3-to-H2 recovery on discharge. This enables high-voltage operation without sacrificing energy density, offering a design principle for durable high-energy lithium-ion batteries.

item.title: Tailored sp 2 ‐C─F Bonding for Reversible Oxygen‐Peroxide Electrocatalysis
item.description:
گرافن دوپ‌شده با فلوئور با پیوند sp2-C-F، الکتروکاتالیز برگشت‌پذیر O2-H2O2 را برای باتری‌های زینک-هوا با توان بالا و دوام طولانی تنظیم می‌کند.
Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Fluorine-doped graphene with tailored sp²-C─F bonding enables reversible O₂–H₂O₂ interconversion by tuning OOH* binding. This replaces sluggish 4e⁻ zinc-air chemistry with faster 2e⁻ pathways, yielding durable, high-power batteries. The work establishes a structure-property principle linking fluorine-induced polarization to oxygen-peroxide kinetics, advancing fluorinated carbons for reversible energy storage.
